About your library in Esbjerg:
Focus on
Psychology, Law, Business Economics, Sociology, and Public Health:
Our collection of books and journals is tailored to the studies offered at SDU Esbjerg: Psychology, Law, Sociology, Business Economics, and Public Health. Additionally, the library holds literature on methodology and other interdisciplinary materials.
At the library in Esbjerg, you will find various types of
study spaces
, allowing you to work both individually and in groups. We also have a reading room/quiet zone with study spaces that can be used if you wish to work in peaceful surroundings. You can also relax in our lounge furniture or take a break and complete a jigsaw puzzle.
SDU’s library is much more than books, so in Esbjerg, you can also borrow equipment such as
GoPros, microphones, dictaphones, board games
, etc. You can also borrow
lockers
, where you can, for example, store books or other belongings.

About your library in Kolding:
The library's permanent collection of books and journals primarily focuses on serving students and researchers within the fields of
design and social sciences
.
In the social sciences, the collection includes materials on business and national economics, organisation and management, marketing, tourism, auditing, accounting, tax law, statistics, and IT.
In the field of design, the collection includes materials on design theory, industrial design, graphic design, design management, architecture, and fashion.
The library features a
quiet reading room with individual study spaces
. The reading room is open 24/7 and is located on the 3rd floor, room 31.45. You can access it via a staircase from the atrium.
At the library, students can borrow keys for lockers to store personal belongings. The lockers are located on the 1st floor near entrance C.

About your library in Odense:
The main branch of the University Library of Southern Denmark in Odense offers several reading rooms, including a large silent reading room with individual study spaces, located with entrance from Gydehutten between U59 and U62, a
thesis reading room
at SDU's main entrance, a
research reading room
at the library's main entrance, and students also have access to a number of
study cells, which can be booked in advance
.
See an
map of the
library here (PDF)
.
About service during holidays in Odense:
The days before Easter there is service at 9.00-15.00
In the summer period (July and August) there is service at 9.00-15.00 (however in week 29 and 30: 10.00 - 14.00). The research reading room is closed in July.
The south desk is closed during the winter holidays (week 7), the autumn holidays (week 42), between Christmas and New Year, the days before Easter, and during the summer period (July-August).

About your library in Slagelse:
Our collection of books and journals reflects the studies at SDU Slagelse:
International Business Communication and Business Administration
. We also have a semester loan shelf with all the required textbooks for individual courses. These books can only be used within the library.
The library features
two separate group rooms
and a number of study spaces.
Group rooms can be booked here
(search for "Room Name" Slagelse B-1.21 or Slagelse B-1.22).
On the 2nd floor, there is a quiet zone with 24/7 access, where you can study undisturbed.
Through the library, you can
borrow a locker
with a lock for your personal belongings. The lockers are located around the Slagelse campus and can be borrowed for one semester at a time. We always have available lockers!
Outside service hours, you can get assistance from the library in Odense at phone number 6550 2100 or
sdub@bib.sdu.dk
.

About your library in Sønderborg:
The library's mission is to serve and support students and researchers at SDU Sønderborg within the three main disciplines:
engineering, communication
, and
social sciences
.
The library offers various types of
study spaces
- individual, group, as well as reading rooms for quiet work. You can also borrow keys for lockers to store personal belongings. The lockers are located on the 1st floor in block E and in the library's reading rooms.
We have set up a
lounge
where you can take a break and relax. Here, you will find various games, puzzles, magazines, and newspapers.
To support the
Green Alsion
project, the library offers an open area, the
Green Corner
, where you can develop and grow your green ideas.
Services and facilities available at all university library locations
We provide a range of physical facilities and services that are available across the university's campus cities:
24/7 Access – round-the-clock access for students and employees with an SDU card at all libraries.
Study Spaces and Group Rooms – quiet zones and flexible work areas for individual and group use.
Print, Scan, and Copy – uniform facilities across all campuses, accessible with SDU login.
Pickup and Return – materials can be picked up and returned both during staffed hours and via self-service.
Guidance – both physically and digitally.
All library branches are designed with a focus on good study conditions and accessibility for everyone.
We are a public library and therefore accessible to all -
see how to become a borrower here
.
